theorem_obligations.intent: If the input is not an Object, IsCallable must return false.
theorem_obligations.precise_statement_in_words: For any argument with isObject argument = false, IsCallable argument evaluates to false.
theorem_obligations.lean_statement_sketch: theorem isCallable_non_object_false (argument : EcmaValue) (h : isObject argument = false) : IsCallable argument = false

theorem_obligations.intent: Object arguments with a [[Call]] internal method evaluate to true.
theorem_obligations.precise_statement_in_words: For any object o whose hasCall field is true, IsCallable (EcmaValue.object o) is true.
theorem_obligations.lean_statement_sketch: theorem isCallable_object_with_call_true (o : EcmaObject) (h : o.hasCall = true) : IsCallable (EcmaValue.object o) = true

theorem_obligations.intent: Object arguments without [[Call]] still evaluate to false.
theorem_obligations.precise_statement_in_words: For any object o with hasCall false, IsCallable (EcmaValue.object o) is false.
theorem_obligations.lean_statement_sketch: theorem isCallable_object_without_call_false (o : EcmaObject) (h : o.hasCall = false) : IsCallable (EcmaValue.object o) = false

theorem_obligations.intent: Characterize exactly when IsCallable returns true in terms of object classification and [[Call]] predicate.
theorem_obligations.precise_statement_in_words: IsCallable argument is true exactly when the argument is an object and its [[Call]] predicate is true.
theorem_obligations.lean_statement_sketch: theorem isCallable_equivalent_branch_predicate (argument : EcmaValue) : IsCallable argument = true ↔ isObject argument = true ∧ hasCallInternalMethod argument = true
theorem_obligations.conclusion: IsCallable argument = true ↔ isObject argument = true ∧ hasCallInternalMethod argument = true

theorem_obligations.intent: IsCallable always returns either true or false, matching deterministic Boolean completion behavior.
theorem_obligations.precise_statement_in_words: For every argument, the result is a Bool value (true or false), matching the deterministic three-step branch execution.
theorem_obligations.lean_statement_sketch: theorem isCallable_is_boolean (argument : EcmaValue) : IsCallable argument = true ∨ IsCallable argument = false
theorem_obligations.conclusion: IsCallable argument = true ∨ IsCallable argument = false
